text:
mira.dev: Quick flag 1: provider bump to hashicorp/aws 4.x landed in release branch and touches route53 module. Can we gate the 03:00 apply until we validate IAM diffs?
jon.k: Good catch. 03:00 window still OK but +hold until IAM check. Which PR?
mira.dev: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pulls/4399. Main changes: provider version, route53 record attr rename. Attaching plan snip.
samg: paste IAM part please, want to ensure no role replacements.
mira.dev: ```
# terraform plan excerpt
~ aws_iam_role.redwood-deploy
  assume_role_policy: "(sensitive)" => "(sensitive)"
~ aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.deploy-attach
  role: "old-name" => "old-name" # unchanged
```
lena.ops: Historically provider-major bumps cause reorder diffs. Suggest pinning to 3.75.0 in the module and re-plan to avoid churn during window.
jon.k: Agreed. Can you open a pin hotfix and run a staging canary? If staging is clean, we keep prod window but split apply.
mira.dev: Opening hotfix now. I'll pin required_providers to ~> 3.75.0 in module root and push PR.
```terraform
required_providers {
  aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 3.75.0" }
}
```
deploy-bot: preflight: branch infra/provider-4x -> detected provider change. terraform plan ok. summary: +3 -1 resources; route53 attr rename noted.
jon.k: Also recommend splitting apply: wave-1 = iam + secrets (low blast), wave-2 = network/route53. Manual approval between waves.
samg: I can take wave-1 approval and run iam smoke checks post-apply. If green, I'll approve wave-2.
lena.ops: Add an explicit deploy-bot approval step and a +15min monitoring buffer before starting wave-2. Reminder: if aborting, use deploy-bot abort and then only force-unlock with oncall signoff.
mira.dev: Hotfix PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pulls/4400. Staging canary scheduled at 23:45 UTC; will not promote automatically.
deploy-bot: staging apply scheduled for infra/provider-pin at 23:45 UTC, awaiting manual trigger to promote.
samg: Staging plan after pin: no IAM replacements; route53 mapping reduced to attribute rename only. Looks good.
mira.dev: Updating release notes: "Pin aws provider to 3.75.0 to avoid transient route53 attribute rename during release. Follow-up upgrade tracked in RFC-2026."
jon.k: For prod: keep 03:00 window, but run wave-1 at T0, wait 15m, then wave-2 at T0+15m. Document rollback criteria: any unexpected IAM role replacement -> abort and revert pin change.
samg: After wave-1 I'll run scripts/iam-smoke.sh and post results. If OK, I'll approve wave-2. If route53 behaves oddly, revert module, re-plan, and reschedule.
deploy-bot: prod apply queue length: 4. This run will reserve a slot.
deploy-bot: prod apply wave-1 started by mira.dev (apply id r1-5566).
deploy-bot: prod apply wave-1 completed successfully.
samg: iam smoke results: assume-role ok, lambda invoke ok, perms as expected. Approving wave-2.
deploy-bot: prod apply wave-2 started by samg (apply id r2-7788).
deploy-bot: prod apply wave-2 completed: 1 route53 record changed (attribute mapping only), no resource replacements.
mira.dev: DNS checks and traffic verification all green. Closing out. Will file follow-up RFC to coordinate major provider upgrades and a test matrix.
jon.k: Nice coordination. I'll add a short post-release note and link to the RFC in the release board. Thanks all :thumbsup:
